t: Shanghai Special District Court Warrant No. 4202 To Arrest Zau Hoong Hoong For Being Communist

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C & S. B. REGISTRY. Special Branch S.2. Station. No. D 3378. Date April 27, 1932. Due 28/4/32）

Subject (in full) Shanghai Special District Court Warrant No. 4202, dated
April 25, 1932.

Made by D.S. Moore. ........................................ Forwarded by ........................................

At 3.15 p.m. April 26, members of the Special Branch
accompanied by a detective from Central Station and a represent-
ative of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau attempted to execute
the above numbered warrant at the Keu Hwa Silk Shop (久華綢緞號),
210 Nanking Road in an effort to arrest Zau Hoong Hoong (曹洪洪)
and one Tseu ( 周 ) shop assistants, who are wanted by the
Public Safety Bureau for being communists. The two wanted men
were not on the premises at the time of the Police visit and
although detectives were left to await their return they failed
to re-appear. The warrant is therefore herewith returned
for cancellation.

Great difficulty is experienced in the execution
of this class of warrant, for apart from the name or names
contained thereon we have no means of identifying the wanted
persons. There is nothing to prevent a wanted man giving a
false name and we have no means at our disposal to disprove his
words for invariably the Public Safety Bureau detectives know
nothing of the person wanted and less of his habitual address.

D.B. Moore.
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
Supt. Jan and S2,
In cases of this kind the Chinese
Authorities should be persuaded to allow
the Municipal Police to keep the premises
under observation for a day or two or
three.

（批：Noted ABB 27/4/32. File 996 98.4:32. (M. 1202) Warrant returned to Supt Whiting 27.4.32. M.P. 27:4:32.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

（印：档案号 上海公共租界工部局警务处 C & S. B. 登记室。特务科 S.2. 站。编号 D 3378。日期 1932年4月27日。到期日 1932年4月28日）

事由（全称）上海特区法院第4202号逮捕令，日期为
1932年4月25日。

由 D.S. Moore 制作。........................................ 转呈人 ........................................

1932年4月26日下午3时15分，特务科成员在中央巡捕房一名侦探及上海市公安局一名代表的陪同下，试图在南京路210号的久華綢緞號执行上述编号的逮捕令，以逮捕被公安局通缉的两名共产党嫌疑犯：曹洪洪 (Zau Hoong Hoong) 和一名姓周 (Tseu) 的店员。警方到达时，这两名通缉犯不在店内，尽管留有侦探等候其返回，但他们并未再次出现。因此，现将该逮捕令退回，予以注销。

在执行此类逮捕令时遇到了极大困难，因为除了逮捕令上所载的姓名外，我们没有任何手段来识别通缉犯。通缉犯完全可以提供假名，而我们手头没有任何手段来驳斥其说辞，因为公安局的侦探 invariably（总是）对通缉犯本人一无所知，对其常住地址更是知之甚少。

D.B. Moore.
副督察 (D. S.)

特务科主管警官。
致 Jan 警司及 S2，
在此类案件中，应说服中国当局允许
工部局警务处对相关场所进行一至三天的监视。

（批注：已知悉 ABB 1932年4月27日。档案 996 98.4:32。（M. 1202）逮捕令于1932年4月27日退回 Whiting 警司。M.P. 1932年4月27日。）
